spec_match.rationale: Matches the spec's CompileAssertion semantics and the explainer's desugarings; all three escapes agreed with their modifier forms on every preset with the flag (e.g. \Z at 4,5,6 on "a\r\nb\r\n").

interactive.rationale: Real inputs and buttons drive live RegExp calls; readouts update on every interaction.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Feature-index blurb describes exactly what this page does.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers CRLF splitting by \Z, two trailing terminators, and empty input; textarea CR normalisation is worked around by keeping preset strings exact.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite (10 assertions) returns false for the 7 feature-dependent assertions on default Chrome 153 and passes 10/10 with --js-flags=--js-regexp-buffer-boundaries.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chrome for Testing 153 via Playwright, default and --js-flags=--js-regexp-buffer-boundaries, at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 touch; every button/checkbox/radio clicked; scrollWidth-innerWidth = 0; zero console errors, no failed requests; screenshots in the builder scratchpad. chrome-devtools-mcp was not available in this environment, so DevTools-backed verification and Chrome 160 stable capture are outstanding.

telemetry_health.rationale: showcaseTelemetry.assert fires on the primary action with supported/labelled details; fallback branches are labelled honest-unsupported/honest-fallback.

design_system.rationale: Only design-system variables; button background overrides also set color; AA pairs (black/ivory, emerald-dark and rose on stone).

accessibility.rationale: Native labelled controls, fieldsets, role=status live readouts, focusable named table regions, visual strips aria-hidden with equivalent text. Accessibility tree not inspected (no chrome-devtools-mcp).

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No horizontal overflow at 360x740 DPR3; controls wrap with 44px targets; desktop and mobile both exercised.

openQuestions.title: Add U+2029 preset
openQuestions.detail: PARAGRAPH SEPARATOR is covered by conformance but not by a preset button.

guidanceConsulted.query: live regex tester input with accessible result output
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use native labelled inputs/checkboxes and expose results through text, not colour alone.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Every input/textarea has a <label>; flag checkboxes are native and wrapped in labelled fieldsets; verdicts are words (pass/FAIL/yes/NO) in role=status readouts.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Headless Chrome for Testing 153 via Playwright, default and --js-flags=--js-regexp-buffer-boundaries, at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 touch; every button/checkbox/radio clicked; scrollWidth-innerWidth = 0; zero console errors, no failed requests; screenshots in the builder scratchpad

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive comparison table without horizontal overflow on mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Wrap wide tables in a focusable role=region scroll container named by the caption.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Result tables sit in .table-wrap (overflow-x:auto, tabindex=0, role=region, aria-labelledby=caption) so the page itself never scrolls horizontally.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: document scrollWidth equals innerWidth at 360px on all pages

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive comparison table without horizontal overflow on mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep touch targets usable and let control rows wrap.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All buttons and checkbox/radio labels are min 44px tall and wide; preset and flag rows flex-wrap.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Playwright size audit found no control under 44x44 at 360px

summary: Inspection tool: every zero-width index for \A, ^, \z, $, \Z with m on/off over presets containing CRLF, lone CR, U+2028, double newline and empty input, plus sugar-vs-desugar agreement.
